description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120). Key tables with k LONG and a payload: KA(k primary key: 3, 1, 2 inserted in that order; t 'a1', 'a2', 'a3') and KB(k no index: 2, 1, 3, 1 inserted in that order; u 'b1' to 'b4'); KC and KD the same rows with the index on the other side (KC no index, KD k indexed, not unique); KE and KF both indexed (KE primary key, KF indexed); KG and KH neither indexed. For each pair: SELECT t, u FROM first INNER JOIN second ON first.k = second.k, then with the tables listed the other way. Asks whether the indexed side is probed (inner) and which order the outer side is read in (storage or key order).
